# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 113 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52-53 | Coptic

---

## Saying 113

**1** His disciples asked him: "When will the kingdom come?" Jesus said: "It won't come by looking for it. No one will be able to say, 'Here it is!' or 'There it is!' The Father's kingdom is already spread out across the earth — and people just don't see it."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Looking for it" — the watching/observing of signs
- "Already spread out" — the "already" emphasizes the present reality
- "People just don't see it" — the "just" highlights the irony of blindness to what is present
